provenance.assumptions: Real geometry; synthetic central bases, 4 aircraft, camera and weather

limitations: Partial series: anchor 1 only; not a production acceptance or optimality proof.
Customer polygons; synthetic aircraft, base, camera, no wind; other customer obstacle/airspace layers not connected.
Operational benchmark samples exclude geometry below 1 square metre; API import preserves all objects.
Audit status, feasibility and deadline satisfaction must be assessed separately.
No --exports in this interrupted series; independent integration tests cover exports.
Memory is cumulative worker peak RSS, not per-case allocation.
Raw local request/response snapshots under ignored work/ are not required to replay the tracked scenario factory.
